notes.content:

- Fixed an issue with low FPS not registering spike collision
- Fixed an issue with low FPS deceleration
- Fixed a screen resolution issue

notes.title: Post-Release Update!
notes.content:
First of all, a big thanks from the both of us to everyone who helped make the release and everything head up to it special.  All of these and more made it a day that exceeded our expectations heading in:

- Overwhelmingly positive reception, reviews, and reactions
- Thousands of viewers seeing the game streamed live on Twitch in the first week
- World first 100% completion (Vellhart), and first 100% completion which came entirely after release (Yagamoth)
- Tons of feedback about how to improve the game!

Regarding that last note, I'll share a bit of what we're working on and what to expect in upcoming patches.  The thee main themes are speedrunning, improved/expanded controller support, and platform ports. Below are just a few items we are working on for each:

Speedrunning:
- Implementing hard resets of monsters, bullets, etc on death, giving you consistent "cycles" to work with
- Timer which starts on new save file, and tracks total completion of each world and entire game
- Leaderboards tracking the previous item, both for any % and 100%
- More hotkeys and shortcuts to skip non-gameplay sections

Controller support:
- Revamping the underlying code to provide support to many times the number of controllers we support now
- You shouldn't see much change from this in normal gameplay

Platform ports:
- Linux and Mac are first on our list
- Other goals: Xbox, Ps4, Switch

Thanks again to everyone playing DYE and looking forward to making your experience even better

- Mike and Danny

notes.title: Prepare to DYE! / Thank You!
notes.content:
The PC version of DYE is officially available on Steam now, and just wanted to take a minute to thank everyone for the positive reception.  Launch day was incredible.  ːdyehueː

[h1]YouTubers / Twitch Streamers[/h1]
A BIG THANK YOU to all of the YouTubers and Twitch streamers who have been playing over the past two weeks.  Hanging out in chat and watching everyone progress through the game has been amazing.

We've been hanging out in Vellhart's channel for a good part of the week watching him complete every single challenge in the game.  He finished the 100% run last night, so congrats to Vellhart for being the world first!
[b]Vellhart's Channel: [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/vellhart]https://www.twitch.tv/vellhart[/url]

We also got an overwhelming warm welcome from Lethalfrag's channel last night. ːdyechillː

Mike has been doing a great job of curating our "Big List of VODs" which you can find here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/503550/discussions/0/135509472111566512/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/503550/discussions/0/135509472111566512/[/url]

[h1]Speed Running[/h1]
The most common comment we saw during these past two weeks was "this game would be great for speed running."  We agree, and we are looking at ways to improve the game for speed runners.  If you have any requests or ideas that might make speed runs more enjoyable, then shoot us an email at [b]info[at]batcountrygames[dot]com[/b].

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We've got a couple of quality of life improvements that will be coming in the next patch, as well as some minor difficulty adjustments.

Our next top priorities are the [b]Linux and Mac[/b] releases.  We're working to get those out as soon as possible.

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
Really glad you guys are digging the music, and got a couple of requests to make it available outside of Steam.  Working on getting it available on other storefronts, but for now there's also my Bandcamp located here:
[url=https://dannystracener.bandcamp.com/releases]https://dannystracener.bandcamp.com/releases[/url] ːdyepigmentː

Again, thanks to everyone for the super positive feedback so far.  Hope you guys enjoy the game, and try not to DYE.  ;)

-- Danny and Mike at Bat Country Games
